title: Remek Kossacz - Colored Corners
htmlContent:
Remek Kossacz's "Colored Corners" is everything you hope to hear when pressing play on a record. It’s that music that makes you enjoy life that much more, as you feel the heart and soul put into the music, coming out your speaker to make something truly unforgettable. Your new favorite song is waiting for you, if you hit play on this one of a kind jam.

The sound is infectious, with grooves that are enticing and make you want to hear what’s next. Vocally the song marvels with a tone that you feel in your spirit, with it delivering the writing to perfection, as the music and vocals work in their own divine way to make something special to offer to the world.
